description: Find independent businesses near a town, borough or postcode in England. Trades: salon, barber or beauty (one list, held in Greater Manchester, Leeds, Liverpool, Sheffield and Newcastle) or dental (independent practices across England; also takes a region such as London or North West). Returns public fields only: name, street, postcode, the shop or practice line when we hold no owner, whether we hold the owner and what an unlock costs. Owner names and numbers never appear here. Pass a result's id to unlock to get them. No sign-in needed. When you are signed in, results also say which owners your desk has already unlocked.

limit.description: How many results, up to 30. Default 20.

place.description: A town, borough, region or UK postcode, for example Leeds, Bolton, LS6 or M20 2AB

trade.description: salon, barber, beauty or dental. Salon, barber and beauty search the same list.

name: search
title: Search businesses near a place
